name: geoviz
description: Website AI-readiness check for businesses: a 0-100 score, six findings, prioritized improvements, and evidence, from GeoViz.

interface.longDescription:
GeoViz checks how clearly a business website can be read and understood by AI systems. Give it a public website address (optionally with the business name, city, and state) and it returns a website AI-readiness score from 0 to 100 with six findings: business identity, location (local businesses only), services, contact consistency, structured data, and overall recommendation readiness. Each result includes up to three prioritized improvements, the evidence behind them, and the date checked.

GeoViz first decides whether the site belongs to a local business or an online/software business and scores it accordingly. Local businesses are checked for LocalBusiness structured data, address, and service-area signals. Online businesses are checked for Organization, WebSite, and product schema instead, and are not penalized for lacking a storefront address or opening hours.

What it is not: GeoViz does not ask ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Perplexity about the business, and the result does not show whether any AI system recommends it. It reads only the public homepage, robots.txt, and sitemap.xml. No login, no account, and nothing you enter is stored.

GeoViz fetches public websites only. Private-network, local, and cloud-metadata addresses are refused.
capabilities: Check a public business website's AI readiness on a 0-100 scale
Score local and online businesses by the signals that apply to each
Explain six readiness findings with the evidence behind them
Suggest up to three prioritized website improvements
defaultPrompt: Check whether my business website is ready for AI search and assistants.
